name: photo-riso-poster
title_zh: 把一张照片拆成可印刷的孔版档案海报
tagline_zh: 照片变海报，不是滤镜，是拆解：数出画面里的数量、间距、遮挡、方向、颜色角色，再用 2–3 色孔版油墨和证据字体重排。
tagline_en: Turn a photo into a riso archive poster—not a filter, but a teardown: count spacing, occlusion, direction, color.
desc_en: Turn a photo or a text theme into one quiet riso-print archive poster. For a photo, deconstruct its observable facts (counts, spacing, occlusion, direction, color roles) and rebuild them as a sparse 2–3 ink risograph composition on temperature-matched paper, with typography that also carries the evidence; for a text theme, distill one imageable idea. Aspect ratio follows the source photo. Generate
why_zh: 它不套模板，而是从照片里提取可观测事实，再按事实决定构图和用色。每张海报都是唯一解。
why_en: No templates—it extracts observable facts from the photo and lets them dictate composition and ink choice. Every poster is a.
limit_zh: 只处理单张照片或单一文本主题；不生成多页 PDF，不输出印刷分色文件，只给 RGB 预览。需要本地有 Python 和。
limit_en: Single photo or one text theme only; no multi-page PDF, no print-ready separations—just RGB preview. Requires local Python + imaging libs; busy.
